sources.entry: 🏙 High Reliability Infrastructure migrations, Julia Evans.

summary.title: High Reliability Infrastructure migrations
summary.one_liner: You learn a toolbox of techniques for derisking infrastructure migrations while keeping very high uptime, illustrated with Stripe's Kubernetes and Envoy experience.
takeaways: Companies with 99.99% or higher uptime requirements can still make significant infrastructure changes safely.
The talk presents a toolbox of techniques for derisking migrations.
Examples are drawn from Stripe's experience running Kubernetes and Envoy.
summary.summary: This is a talk by Julia Evans, dated December 11, 2018, on Speaker Deck. It addresses how companies with very high availability requirements (99.99% uptime or higher) can run new software in production and make significant infrastructure changes without sacrificing availability. The description promises a toolbox of derisking techniques, with examples from Stripe's Kubernetes and Envoy work. The page text is a short description only, so the specific techniques are not listed here.
